description: List Muse trash entries (read-only). Use trash.put to move files into recoverable trash and trash.restore to recover them.

trash.list.description: List every entry in Muse's recoverable trash (trash_id, status, expiry date, original path, top-level contents). Takes no parameters.

trash.put.description: Move one file or directory into Muse's recoverable trash; returns a trash_id (entries expire 30 days after trashing).

trash.restore.description: Move an active trash entry back out (to its original path, or custom_path). Never overwrites an existing path.
